items.name: Yuntong Technology - Lottery Gaming & Live Interactive Platform
items.content: Yuntong's core platform, split into gaming and live streaming. The gaming side runs on an Nx monorepo with NestJS microservices, where each game format is broken into its own API, Socket, business service, and asynchronous consumer so they scale horizontally on their own. Socket.IO pushes live rounds and draws, Kafka carries cross-service event streams, and Redis with Bull Queue back caching and settlement. Live at gamilive.com.

items.name: Sugarbee - High-End Dating App
items.content: A dating app for a high-end audience, where I owned the frontend, backend, CMS, and operations dashboard. Matching engine 2.0, subscription payments and virtual points, real-time chat and push, plus real-person face verification, AWS Rekognition moderation, and a Redis caching layer. Live at sugarbee.vip.

items.name: Vertical AI Kit - RAG Solution Factory for Vertical Industries
items.content: A PoC I built myself, with no paying customers. One RAG core: swap the industry pack and it serves another industry. I wrote the retrieval, evaluation, and resilience frameworks myself, without LangChain. Both packs, manufacturing and retail, were evaluated offline against a locally hosted model with all six metrics clearing their thresholds. Two-tier caching brought a single query from 52s to 1.1s, and multi-turn query rewriting raised MRR from 72.9% to 100% on that offline set.

items.name: Bound - Interest-Based Social Matching App
items.content: A cross-platform social matching app in Flutter, built around AI matching, interest communities (Circles), and chat coaching. I took it from product strategy and UI design through to full-stack implementation. AI jobs run asynchronously through SQS with Firebase pushing results back, and moderation goes through tiered Claude AI and AWS Rekognition. Live at bound-app.com.

items.name: AI Concierge with Voice Betting - High-Risk Payments PoC
items.content: The AI can only draft a bet intent that waits for confirmation, and the charge fires only once the player confirms it. That limit sits in the architecture layer. A Python RAG/STT service behind a Node.js gateway scored Recall@3 of 92.7% on a 150-question evaluation set and got 8/8 on the cases that must go to a human; adding a rule layer took 30 adversarial prompts from 27/30 to 30/30.

items.name: Coffee Chat - Coffee-Break Meetup Platform
items.content: A meetup platform where strangers meet and talk for about as long as one cup of coffee. I did the product, the design, and the full stack on my own. The frontend runs on Next.js App Router with Tailwind, and data and accounts sit on a BaaS. Live at coffee-chat.tw.

archiveItems.name: Goats Humor (Outsource, 2022) - Customized Shopify E-commerce
archiveItems.content: A rebranding project for a tea retailer, with Shopify as the backend and admin console and a custom storefront UI. I managed the project and worked on UI development, automated deployment, and SEO.

archiveItems.name: iflubby (Outsource, 2022) - Pet Services Platform Backend
archiveItems.content: Planned and built the core backend, integrated Facebook / Google / Line / Apple SSO and Google APIs, and wrote the API documentation for the frontend team.

archiveItems.name: Anko (Outsource, 2022) - MessageBird Chat Integration System
archiveItems.content: Brought a client's Line@ and WhatsApp Business accounts into one conversation dashboard. I picked up the codebase from a previous freelancer and handled everything needed to reach production: cleanup, testing, containerization, and the production environment.

archiveItems.name: Numbers Link - Fair Random Number Platform
archiveItems.content: Used blockchain immutability to compute numbers from several data vendors into one fair random number. I was the main backend developer and also wrote part of the EOS smart contracts.

archiveItems.name: Twin City Investment - Lending Management System
archiveItems.content: Simplified loan applications on top of an involved review workflow that needs a lot of documents and reports. I worked on planning, analysis, and the backend, and it was my first time using TypeScript with NestJS.

archiveItems.name: Banana Life - Video Streaming Platform
archiveItems.content: Built on AWS, with Lambda and FFmpeg scripts handling video Gaussian blur and transcoding. I owned the backend and the admin console and worked with the frontend and an outsourced app team.

archiveItems.name: Equipment Maintenance System
archiveItems.content: Wrote the system specifications and built the backend architecture, and helped the company move to a GraphQL-style API design.

archiveItems.name: House Viewing Reception System
archiveItems.content: Took part in integration planning and helped the client adopt Salesforce and a Line@ chatbot.
